steps.label: marketing_homepage
steps.notes: publora.com hero: 'The Publishing API for the Agent Era' — one HTTPS call, MCP, 10 platforms. Positions developer/agent buyer.

steps.label: signup
steps.notes: Signup sidebar copy: 'Connect your social accounts, schedule posts across all platforms' — social-scheduler framing, not API-first. Clean email/password form; no intent fork.

steps.label: post_signup_channels
steps.notes: After signup, redirect to /dashboard/accounts. Ten OAuth connect buttons (Instagram, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Mastodon, Bluesky, X, Telegram, Facebook). Empty state: 'Connect a channel to get started'. 0/3 free channels.

steps.label: home_dashboard
steps.notes: Home shows 0 connections, 0 published, 0 posts/week, 'No drafts yet'. Add-draft CTAs with no guided path to API/MCP value.

steps.label: api_page
steps.notes: API keys creatable without connecting social — '+ Create New Key' and curl examples ready. Not surfaced in default post-signup path despite homepage API positioning.

steps.label: mcp_page
steps.notes: MCP config with Cursor/Claude/Codex chips and copy-paste .mcp.json snippet. Requires API key from API page. Discoverable only via sidebar — not onboarding default.
